name: Unity Change Loop
description: Resolve -> inspect -> smallest change -> compile -> logs -> tests -> observe, with named gates and cited evidence. 'Done' is refused unless the required gates are green (ADR-0015/0018).

phases.description: Resolve the request to concrete files and symbols.

steps.description: Resolve the request to the files/symbols in scope and record the change scope.

artifact.note: Change scope recorded for the request.

phases.description: Read the current code/scene before touching it.

steps.description: Read the target code, scene, or prefab and note the current behaviour.

artifact.note: Target inspected and current behaviour noted.

phases.description: Make the smallest change that satisfies the request.

steps.description: Apply the smallest change in scope; no drive-by edits.

artifact.note: Diff reviewed against the change scope.

phases.description: Compile and confirm fresh assemblies, not a silent no-op.

steps.description: Compile and confirm fresh assemblies (not a silent no-op).

phases.description: Read the Editor/runtime logs for errors introduced by the change.

steps.description: Read the Editor/runtime logs for errors introduced by the change.

phases.description: Run the applicable tests; green tests are required for done.

steps.description: Run EditMode/PlayMode tests; green tests are required for done.

phases.description: Observe the result (screenshot/visual verification) when relevant.

steps.description: Capture a screenshot / visual verification when relevant.

artifact.note: Screenshot captured when the change is visual.
